verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing/metering layer built on top of Stripe, with an `attach` API that handles new subscriptions/upgrades/downgrades and a CLI that syncs pricing plans in a single command, suggesting reasonably fast setup. However, there's no direct evidence of a turnkey checkout page or explicit same-day payment acceptance flow, and the product only works atop Stripe (comm-4), meaning a founder still needs a separate Stripe account/setup for actual card processing. Missing for 10: an end-to-end checkout UI or hosted payment page, explicit time-to-first-payment claims, and independent confirmation of same-day integration speed.
